attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT gm.symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS cls
INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb
  ON cb.class_symbol_id = cls.symbol_id
INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS gm
  ON gm.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cls.symbol_id
INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.file_profile AS cf
  ON cf.file_id = cls.file_id
INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.file_profile AS mf
  ON mf.file_id = gm.file_id
LEFT JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS bs
  ON bs.symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id
WHERE cls.kind = 'class'
  AND cf.is_test = FALSE
  AND mf.is_test = FALSE
  AND gm.kind = 'method'
  AND gm.name = 'get_columns'
  AND gm.has_docstring = FALSE
  AND cb.base_name LIKE '%SQLDatabase'
  AND (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL
       OR (bs.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND bs.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'))
ORDER BY gm.symbol_id

request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists the symbol IDs of the get_columns methods that production classes define themselves, where those classes directly inherit from the SQLDatabase base connector declared in the connectors base module. It uses the class base records to find the subclasses, the symbol catalog to locate each class's own get_columns method and check that it has no docstring, and the file catalog to drop anything located in test files. Each qualifying symbol is returned once, sorted by symbol ID.
